title: Renewing a license Thanksgiving week? What Pontotoc drivers need to know before a trip to Tupelo or New Albany
excerpt: Mississippi allows eligible drivers to renew online every other time. For those who need a station, the holiday changes the usual weekday schedule.
locality: Pontotoc County, Mississippi, and nearby state driver service stations in Tupelo and New Albany.

How to renew a Mississippi driver’s license

facts.statement: Pontotoc County drivers who renewed their Mississippi license online last time will need to visit a driver service station for their next renewal. Anyone planning a trip to Tupelo or New Albany over Thanksgiving has a shorter week to work with. State offices observe the holiday Thursday, Nov. 26, and the governor has left Friday’s hours up to each agency.
facts.evidence: Renewal page requires alternating in-person and online renewals. Proclamation and DPS holiday exception establish the Thursday holiday and the separate Friday discretion.
facts.date_context: November 21, 2026, ahead of Thanksgiving on November 26 and Friday, November 27. The governor signed the proclamation October 6.

facts.identities: Mississippi Department of Public Safety, Mississippi Driver Service Bureau and Gov. Tate Reeves.

facts.statement: The Tupelo station is at 589 Coley Road. In New Albany, the station is at 1103 Bratton Road. Both list regular weekday hours of 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. The Driver Service Bureau recommends making an appointment and lists 601-487-7028 as its contact number for north Mississippi stations.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc County drivers who renewed their Mississippi license online last time will need to visit a driver service station for their next renewal. Anyone planning a trip to Tupelo or New Albany over Thanksgiving has a shorter week to work with. State offices observe the holiday Thursday, Nov. 26, and the governor has left Friday’s hours up to each agency.

The Tupelo station is at 589 Coley Road. In New Albany, the station is at 1103 Bratton Road. Both list regular weekday hours of 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. The Driver Service Bureau recommends making an appointment and lists 601-487-7028 as its contact number for north Mississippi stations.

Check before making a Friday trip. The proclamation Gov. Tate Reeves signed Oct. 6 allows agency heads to close offices for all or part of Nov. 27 and to arrange staffing as needed. The proclamation gives no Friday opening time for either driver service station.

For drivers considering an online renewal, the last transaction matters. An eligible driver who renewed in person last time may renew online this time. A driver whose license carries restriction D, which requires a new examination, must go in person. Changing the last name on a license also requires an office visit with original documents supporting the change.
